enrichment method: Primary hepatocytes extracted from Dyrk1b HepKO mice and Flox controls were transfected with Ad-encoding Flag-FoxO1, and affinity purified.
fractionation method: Flag-FoxO1 band was then excised from the Coomassie-stained gel and analyzed by mass spectrometry.
labeling: Flag-FoxO1 band was then excised from the Coomassie-stained gel and analyzed by mass spectrometry.
